paper_title: Nondeterministic Polynomial-time Problem Challenge An Ever-Scaling   Reasoning Benchmark for LLMs
caption: Ever-scalingness
model_annotation: The pie chart, titled “Ever-scalingness,” visually represents four conceptual dimensions of a benchmark for large language models (LLMs) in tackling NP problems, each quadrant labeled with a core attribute and an associated icon. The top-left yellow segment, labeled “Complexity,” is paired with a ladder icon and associated with the descriptor “Uncrushable,” suggesting resilience under computational load. The top-right light blue segment, “Instance,” features a shield icon and is labeled “Unhackable,” implying robustness against adversarial manipulation. The bottom-left red segment, “Oversight,” includes a clipboard with a checkmark and is tagged “Auto-verifiable,” highlighting the capacity for automated validation. The bottom-right green segment, “Coverage,” displays a globe with gears and is marked “General,” indicating broad applicability. Each quadrant is visually distinct in color and accompanied by a callout box with a corresponding keyword, reinforcing the four pillars of the benchmark’s design philosophy. The chart’s structure emphasizes balance and equal weighting among the four dimensions, with no numerical percentages provided, focusing instead on conceptual categorization.
